description: ARCHIVAL_REWARD_GATE_M1.md §5 activation-boundary KAT fixture (cases G-1..G-10). The base scenario is the consensus_state_kat_v1.json epoch_close replay (same hand-derived values, WS-1 ledger-sourced work: age_milli(s42)=floor(4·1000/11)=363, g=1181, scarcity=590, Σ=(590+500)+(500+590)+1000=3180) with `frozen_shard_count` and `k_cover` supplied per case by the test — parameterized, never baked from the provisional constant, so the corpus survives the §4 seal without rewrite (§5: 'parameterized over K_COVER'). Per §11 M2-5, shard 42 freezes at height 70000 — inside the would-be-gated window of the G-3 story — so the boundary identity is exercised with the age term live (363), not degenerately zero.

genesis_edge.description: G-4 variant: close_block_height 5000 < settlement_epoch_blocks 10000 ⇒ chain_epochs = 0 ⇒ shard_age_milli's genesis branch fires ('everything is hot'). Freeze heights lowered below the close so the branch — not the close≤freeze short-circuit — produces the zero. Hand-derived ungated values (WS-1 ledger-sourced work): ages all 0 ⇒ g = 1000 ⇒ scarcity = 1000/R per shard (500, 500, 1000); work b0 = 1000, b2 = 500+500 = 1000, b4 = 1000; curve identity below 4000; Σ = 3000.

single_shard_variant.description: G-10 variant: credits touch exactly one distinct shard (index 0, shard 42) — fewer than k_cover = 3 — while frozen_shard_count is injected well above threshold. Hand-derived (WS-1 ledger-sourced work): members b0/b2 (b1 bad-interval, b3 foundation); R_market(s42) = 2; both member credits on s42 earn scarcity(R=2, age=363) = 590 from the ledger alone; Σ = curve(590) + curve(590) = 1180.
